description: Gets setup links for, or changes, the developer's payout account (Stripe Connect; one for all their apps, or per project with its own Stripe). "onboarding_link": a page where the developer, not you, verifies identity and bank in Stripe (never ask for them in chat); paid products stay hidden until the account is active. "dashboard_link": their Stripe Dashboard (payments, refunds, disputes, payouts). "set_descriptor": the bank-statement prefix. "disconnect" (confirm: true) hides every paid product in all their apps; the account is kept and onboarding_link reconnects it. Neblla takes 1 % of each sale before tax. More: neblla_get_llms tools/payments_account
